components.css: .ds-ix{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:2px solid var(--ink,#161616);color:var(--ink,#161616)}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:9ch 1fr auto;column-gap:24px;align-items:baseline;padding-block:20px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink,#161616)}.ds-no{font:400 20px/1.6 'Londrina Solid','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}.ds-t{display:block;width:fit-content;color:inherit;font:900 clamp(24px,1.2vw + 16px,30px)/1.02 'Londrina Solid','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;transform-origin:left center}.ds-t:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:3px;text-underline-offset:.12em}.ds-t:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#161616);outline-offset:4px}.ds-meta{font:400 15px/1.6 'Hanken Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--mute,#5c3a37);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.ds-tick{display:none;width:.9em;height:.7em;margin-left:.25em;overflow:visible}.ds-tick path{fill:none;stroke:var(--ink,#161616);stroke-width:3.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.is-read .ds-tick{display:inline-block}@keyframes ds-wobble{0%,100%{rotate:0deg}30%{rotate:-1.6deg}65%{rotate:1.1deg}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-t:hover,.ds-t:focus-visible{animation:ds-wobble 420ms ease-in-out}}

narrative.overview:
Every page is one sheet of flat pastel paper with black ink on it. Condensed, slightly hand-cut capitals do the shouting (wordmark, navigation, titles, labels); a calm grotesk carries the reading. The owner's own black line drawings are the main character, and until they exist each one is held open by a hand-drawn dashed placeholder frame. Everything sits in one centred column, openers centred, running text left-aligned in a reading measure.

The system is minimal by commitment: one ground colour per page, one ink, one rule weight, no cards, no shadows, no second accent. Playfulness comes from three small things only: a few ink blocks set slightly askew (the wordmark, the post number, the placeholder tag), a gentle wobble when a drawing or title is touched, and a hand-drawn tick that marks posts already read.

The present implementation is Astro (`src/styles/global.css` holds every token; components in `src/components/`, pages in `src/pages/`). The system is stack-neutral: a PHP template set reproduces it by emitting the same custom properties on `:root`, the same `data-ground` attribute on `<html>`, and the component markup described below.
keyCharacteristics: One flat pastel ground per page: pink for home, Geschichten, Über mich and 404; butter for Projekte and every Projekt post.
Black ink for everything else: type, 2px rules, drawings, figures, stamps.
Condensed uppercase display capitals against a calm sans for reading.
One centred 960px column on an 8px module.
Hand-drawn marks (dashed frame, tick, drawings) instead of icons or decoration.
Motion is a single hover wobble, never on load.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: A page is drenched in exactly one pastel, chosen by section. No white surfaces, no cards on a second tint, no mixing pink and butter on one page.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Rule
rules.body: There is no accent colour. Emphasis is made with weight, size, capitals, underline or an ink block, never with hue.

rules.name: The Paired Mute Rule
rules.body: Secondary text uses the mute that belongs to the current ground, never a grey and never ink at reduced opacity.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display capitals label and announce; the sans reads. Never set running text in Londrina, never set a title in the sans.

rules.name: The Capitals Are the Display Rule
rules.body: Londrina is always uppercase. Lowercase only appears in the sans.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If a thing needs separation, use a 2px ink rule or an ink block, never a shadow or a lighter surface.

dos: Do set the page ground by section with one attribute on the root element (`data-ground="butter"` for Projekte), and read colours only through `--ground`, `--mute` and `--ink`.
Do separate things with 2px ink rules and space on the 8px module.
Do give every post its number ("Nr. 14") in the index, on the post page and in the pager.
Do draw figures and diagrams in `currentColor` so they follow the ink.
Do keep a drawing placeholder visible, and say what belongs there, until the owner supplies the drawing.
Do keep the wobble small, on hover and focus only, and switched off for reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce white or tinted cards, a second accent colour, gradients or shadows.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph icons; marks are hand-drawn SVG in ink.
Don't set running text in the display face or titles in the sans.
Don't animate anything on page load.
